## AsrSession.onError() method

Subscribe to session-level errors (model load failure, sidecar crash, malformed audio, etc). The session is closed by Moss after an error fires; callers should treat the error as terminal.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onError(callback: (error: Error) => void): UnsubscribeFn;
```
